newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-GRIQUAS IN COMMAND AGAINST N.TRANSVAAL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-GRIQUAS IN COMMAND AGAINST N.TRANSVAAL.

text.p: Northern Transvaal were left needing to score 168 to make Griqualand West bat again at the end of the third day of their Supersport Series match in Kimberley on Sunday.
A career-best 212 from Pieter Barnard helped Griquas to a mammoth total of 541 for six declared after Northerns had been bowled out for 363 on Saturday.
At the close Northerns were 11 without loss in their second innings.

Barnard -- who batted almost seven hours and hit 24 fours and two sixes -- shared stands of 133 with opener Martyn Gidley (61) and 174 with Willie Dry (74) for the third and fourth wickets respectively to bat Griquas into a commanding position.
When Barnard's stay ended after 329 balls Brett Benkenstein scored a maiden half-century to pile on the pain for Northerns in an unbroken 49-run seventh wicket partnership with Wendell Bossenger.
